scientific_integrity: All general Hilbert-space assertions are established by an explicit polar reducing-subspace model and spectral/Calkin functional calculus. Historical novelty cannot be certified independently by literature search.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive-weight paths with one alternating core operator and its adjoint. Arbitrary unrelated block weights and infinite paths are not treated. The finite checker is diagnostic and not an infinite-dimensional certificate.
title: Exact resolvent and essential-resolvent rigidity for alternating-adjoint block paths
